=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml:58-164 (Validate inputs step, `CS_HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS` env, hub fetch); scripts/cs_investigate.sh:79-196 (`if [ -n "${CS_HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-}" ]` block, `cs_oidc_fetch cs-hub`, curl to `${hub_base}/api/tickets/${ticket_id}`) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hub host allowlist `CS_HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS` is opt-in and empty by default, so any HTTPS `hub_url` passes, and the workflow sends a freshly minted `cs-hub` OIDC bearer token to that host. When the allowlist is set, only the hostname is compared, not the port.
  WHY: A caller who controls `hub_url` gets a `cs-hub` token that the real hub accepts and can replay. Severity disagreement: gemini, minimax and luna rate BLOCKER; sonnet and glm rate MAJOR. Sonnet notes that dispatchers already have write access to the caller repository. The highest rating is used.
- scripts/cs_investigate.sh:172-236 (cs_run_engine, `claude_run_selected ... --codex-stdio -- bash ... codex_isolated_exec.sh run`; `124) cs_invalid engine_timeout ;;` at 248); .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml:67 (`timeout-minutes: 60`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The engine call, including the codex fallback branch, has no wall-clock `timeout` wrapper, so the `124) cs_invalid engine_timeout` mapping is never reached from a wall-clock overrun.
  WHY: A hung round, or up to 4 rounds together, can pass the 60-minute job timeout. Actions then cancels the step before `cs_emit` runs, so no `verdict` output is written. This breaks the contract that every later failure emits invalid_verdict and the job stays green. Compare scripts/activation_verify.sh:623, which uses `timeout`.
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml:43-62 (workflow env `AI_ENGINE_*`; no `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY`), 209-215 (comment "without a credential the isolated runner falls back to isolated codex, so these steps never fail the job"); scripts/cs_investigate.sh:244-250 (`76) cs_invalid engine_refused ;;`) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY` is set, so the default `capacity` policy applies. A missing pool credential (no_credential, classified non_capacity) makes `claude_run_selected` return 76 instead of running codex. Every no-credential run ends as `invalid_verdict` with reason=engine_refused, and the workflow and agents.d comment wrongly claim a codex fallback.
  WHY: The issue's "keep the existing codex fallback" is not honored. scripts/ai_engine.sh:33-35/72-76/277-283/517-520/790-793 runs codex only on rc 75. All reviewers rate MAJOR. Gemini cites env at 43-46 and minimax at 60-62; they are merged on the same root cause.
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml:128-135 (`stable_ref='^shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/\.github/workflows/cs_investigate\.yml@refs/tags/stable$'` and branch_ref approvals in "Resolve trusted CS support commit") | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The support-identity step approves refs/tags/stable and branch refs. The broker refuses these (tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:17-22/482-507 `workflow_ref_not_allowed`; broker.test.ts:445), so they can never get a Claude credential.
  WHY: A caller pinned `@stable`, which is the issue's rollout, passes resolve_support and then gets a broker 403 → rc 76 → `invalid_verdict reason=engine_refused` on every run. The dead `stable_ref` clause also suggests @stable is supported when it is not.
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml:222-235 ("Resolve Claude credential" `continue-on-error: true`; "Stage Claude engine support" `::warning::`) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A broker refusal or network failure is absorbed by `continue-on-error: true` and only a `::warning::` is logged, so a mis-pinned caller gets a green job whose only signal is `invalid_verdict reason=engine_refused`.
  WHY: The run uses runner time and emits a misleading verdict, with nothing that fails CI or alerts an operator.
- scripts/cs_verdict.py:358-371 (compose_prompt drop-oldest loop and `encoded[:hard_cap].decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")`) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The ticket is capped at `MAX_TICKET_PROMPT_BYTES` before the per-line `UNTRUSTED_DATA: ` prefix is added. If the ticket alone exceeds the cap, the drop-oldest loop never pops it. The hard_cap byte cut can split a prefix, a UTF-8 codepoint, or a BEGIN/END UNTRUSTED marker pair.
  WHY: An adversarial ticket can yield a prompt with no `END UNTRUSTED` marker, which breaks the invariant that `untrusted_block` (line 253) enforces. Sonnet and glm raise the same issue as hardening suggestions only.
- scripts/cs_verdict.py:168 (`if "pattern" in schema and not re.search(schema["pattern"], value):`) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The stdlib schema validator uses `re.search` for `pattern`, so a partial (substring) match passes. It should use `re.fullmatch`.
  WHY: The current schema anchors every pattern with `^…$`, but a future unanchored pattern would silently accept substrings.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml + scripts/cs_investigate.sh: "Validate inputs" step (`allowed = os.environ.get("CS_HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS", "").split()` / `if allowed and parts.hostname not in allowed`), `CS_HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${{ vars.CS_HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS || '' }}`, `cs_oidc_fetch cs-hub "${runtime}/secrets/hub-auth"`, `curl ... "${hub_base}/api/tickets/${ticket_id}"` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The allowlist is opt-in and empty by default, so the `cs-hub` OIDC token goes to any caller-supplied https host. A set allowlist compares only the hostname, not the port.
  WHY: Whoever can dispatch the wrapper gets a token the real hub accepts. Impact is limited because the dispatcher already has write access to the caller repository. Fix: fail closed inside Actions when the allowlist is empty, or default it to the known hub host.
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml + scripts/cs_investigate.sh: `stable_ref` / branch ref approvals in "Resolve trusted CS support commit"; "Install Claude Code CLI" comment; `76) cs_invalid engine_refused ;;` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The broker refuses refs/tags/stable (tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:17-22). No AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY is set, so the default `capacity` policy returns 76 and codex never runs (scripts/ai_engine.sh:33-35 and 72-76). The codex-fallback comment is wrong.
  WHY: An `@stable` caller gets a broker 403 → rc 76 → `{"outcome":"invalid_verdict"}` reason=engine_refused on every ticket. Fix: drop the stable_ref/branch_ref approvals or set `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY: 'always'`, and correct the comment.
- scripts/cs_investigate.sh: cs_run_engine() `claude_run_selected CS_INVESTIGATE ... --codex-stdio -- bash "${engine_root}/scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh" run --mode read-only ...`, with `timeout-minutes: 60` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The engine call has no wall-clock `timeout` (compare scripts/activation_verify.sh:623). claude_run relies only on the stall guard (scripts/ai_engine.sh:611-616), and the codex fallback is unbounded. There are up to 4 rounds.
  WHY: An overrun cancels the step, `cs_emit` never runs and no verdict is written. `124) cs_invalid engine_timeout` is never reached. Fix: `timeout "${CS_ENGINE_TIMEOUT_SECS:-780}"`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: CI inventory contract (tests/inventory_parity.py): run 43367330104 fails with "docs/INVENTORY.md: Workflows: missing .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml" plus missing scripts/cs_bridge_query.sh, scripts/cs_investigate.sh, scripts/cs_verdict.py, scripts/templates/cs_verdict.v1.schema.json, and the agents.md cross-reference lines.
  Expected change site: docs/INVENTORY.md (## Workflows / ## Scripts), or tests/inventory_exemptions.txt (inside the plan grant's `tests/**`; docs/INVENTORY.md is not).
  Evidence of absen
